definitions.explanation: One of the teeth at the front of the mouth, used for biting into food. Also used of the front teeth of animals such as rabbits and rodents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{前歯|まえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}けた→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and chipped a front tooth.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前歯|まえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧きた。
examples.english: My child's front tooth came out, and an adult tooth is coming in.

examples.japanese: ウサギ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前歯|まえば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{伸|の}び→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧{続|つづ}ける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かじらせる⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A rabbit's front teeth keep growing all its life, so it needs hard things to gnaw on.

notes:
⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (front) + ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth), with rendaku (the h-sound of ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ voiced to b).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前歯|まえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: a front tooth chips
- {前歯|まえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: a front tooth comes out
- {前歯|まえば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to bite with the front teeth
- {出|で}っ{歯|ぱ}: buck teeth (colloquial)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {奥歯|おくば}: back tooth, molar — the opposite end of the mouth
- {門歯|もんし}: incisor — the anatomical term used by dentists
- {八重歯|やえば}: a snaggletooth, a canine that sticks out
